department: CUNY Neuroscience Collaborative (Ph.D. in Biology or Psychology)

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall enrollment.
deadline.quote: Application Deadline: December 1 for fall enrollment (no spring enrollment)

gre_general.value: GRE scores may be submitted optionally but are not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores may be submitted but are not required.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores may be submitted optionally but are not required.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores may be submitted but are not required.

supervisor.value: Applicants should list 6–8 labs of interest on their application and are strongly encouraged to contact prospective faculty before applying; first-year rotations precede dissertation lab selection.
supervisor.quote: Applicants should consult our faculty pages and list 6-8 labs they might be interested in on their application. Applicants are highly encouraged to contact faculty they are interested in working with prior to submitting the application.

also.quote: Faculty from both disciplines work together as a single integrated unit, in the admissions and assessment process, the teaching of an integrated First Year Neuroscience Curriculum, the presentation of a Neuroscience Seminar Series and the supervision of students during First Year Rotations and Dissertation development.

funding.value: Nearly all Graduate Center PhD students receive five-year fellowships covering tuition, and accepted Neuroscience students are considered for the $30,000/year Neuroscience Fellowship.
funding.quote: Note that nearly all Graduate Center Ph.D. students are awarded five-year fellowships that cover the cost of their tuition. | Students accepted into psychology's behavioral cognitive neuroscience program or biology's neuroscience program will be considered for the Neuroscience Fellowship. This award consists of a tuition award, a financial aid fellowship and graduate assistantship totaling $30,000, and eligibility for low-cost individual or family NYSHIP health insurance

entry_route.value: A master's degree is not required prior to starting the Ph.D. program.
entry_route.quote: Unless specifically noted on our deadlines and requirements chart, you do not need to have a master's degree before you start a Ph.D. program.
